description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/inventory-replenishment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryReplenishment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WarehouseStore" name="Warehouse or store" processRef="Process_InventoryReplenishment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Supplier" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Supplier" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReplenishment" name="Inventory replenishment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_InventoryReplenishment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_WarehouseStore" name="Warehouse or store">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Monitoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Threshold</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalMethod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManualCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RestockActivitiesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RestockActivitiesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_InventoryUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InventorySystem" name="Inventory system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventoryLevels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProcurementTeam" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Inventory monitoring begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Predefined reorder threshold reached?" default="Flow_ThresholdNotReached"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethod" name="Choose reorder signal method"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated alert"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Merge reorder signals"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order considering cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RestockActivitiesSplit" name="Begin restock activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RestockActivitiesJoin" name="Restock activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated" name="Inventory levels updated after the restock is complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMonitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdReached" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stockLevel >= reorderThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThresholdNotReached" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalAutomated" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${signalMethod == 'automatedAlert'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignalManual" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${signalMethod == 'manualCheck'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToExpectedDate" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpectedDateToReceive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInspect" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToRecord" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPlace" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectToJoin" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToUpdateLevels" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockActivitiesJoin" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevelsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
